name: SADE Agent Architecture
inspiration: Devika agent pipeline concepts, reimplemented for SADE
principles: GitHub remains the system of record for source code and engineering artefacts.
Agents propose structured work; execution is policy-controlled.
Every engineering task produces an auditable plan, evidence trail and verification result.
Failures return to diagnosis and repair rather than being reported as success.
Commander approval is required before merge to main.

agents.name: SADE Orchestrator
agents.role: Own task state, route work between specialist agents and enforce workflow policy.

agents.name: Planner
agents.role: Convert the Commander objective into an explicit, ordered engineering plan.

agents.name: Recon
agents.role: Inspect repository structure, branches, dependencies, history and relevant files before implementation.

agents.name: Researcher
agents.role: Gather authoritative technical context and repository documentation when the task requires external knowledge.

agents.name: Code Engineer
agents.role: Design and implement production changes using structured file operations.

agents.name: Tester
agents.role: Run appropriate checks and capture reproducible evidence of success or failure.

agents.name: Patcher
agents.role: Diagnose failed checks and make targeted corrective changes before retesting.

agents.name: Browser Verifier
agents.role: Reproduce and verify user-facing web behaviour where browser validation is available.

agents.name: Diff Auditor
agents.role: Review changed files, scope, security, regressions and unintended changes.

agents.name: Git / PR Engineer
agents.role: Prepare branches, commits and pull requests while respecting SADE merge policy.
